mapper.select: SELECT disaster_id, disaster_name, earthquake_full_name, position, ST_AsText(geom) AS geom, intensity, depth, occurrence_time, eq_type, source, eq_addr_code, town_code, is_deleted, magnitude, create_time, update_time, district, province, city FROM xian_earthquake_list ORDER BY occurrence_time DESC

SELECT disaster_id, disaster_name, earthquake_full_name, position, ST_AsText(geom) AS geom, intensity, depth, occurrence_time, eq_type, source, eq_addr_code, town_code, is_deleted, magnitude, create_time, update_time, district, province, city FROM xian_earthquake_list WHERE disaster_id = CAST(#{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS INTEGER)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xian_earthquake_list ( disaster_name, earthquake_full_name, position, geom, depth, occurrence_time, eq_type, source, eq_addr_code, town_code, is_deleted, magnitude, create_time, update_time, district, province, city ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{fullName}, #{position}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326), #{depth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_timestamp(#{dateTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{type}, #{source, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{countyCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{townshipCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, #{magnitude, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE, #{district, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{province, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{city, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
